review_calibration.scope: Full design-to-fit comparison of both pairs, using identical criteria.

review.observations: Both A and B depict a rectangular, wall-mounted display unit with a grey-green metal frame and a dark screen area. The frame in both images features a distinct bevel and corner rivets, consistent with the requested military furniture style. The screen area is a flat, dark inset, representing a clean rigid geometry without textures. The proportions of the frame to the screen area appear consistent between the design (A) and the fitted asset (B).
defects: The fitted asset (B) appears slightly more 'boxy' or thick in depth compared to the design (A), though this may be due to the camera angle.
The screen inset in B appears to have a slightly different border thickness compared to A, though it remains within acceptable stylistic variance.
fixes: Verify the depth of the frame in the fitted asset to ensure it matches the design's profile.
Ensure the screen inset border thickness is uniform across all four sides in the final asset.

acceptance_rule: Export checks pass and visual fit is at least 7/10; reviewer ready flag is retained separately.
earlier_failure_cause: The front-facing fit lacked its dark bezel and its bright glass read as a rear panel. Seed 283 also showed a deep box incompatible with the required .08 m depth; the replacement source targets a shallow panel.
